Causal block skipping in the prefill kernel: for causal launches, each m-block iterates KV only up to min((start_m+1)*BLOCK_M, SEQ_KV) instead of the whole sequence, split into an unmasked phase over KV blocks fully below the diagonal (no bounds/causal mask, unmasked K/V loads) and a masked phase over the diagonal block(s) only.

Prefill tile/warp/stage sweep: wrap the prefill/non-split _attn_fwd launch (Sq > 16) in triton.autotune over (BLOCK_M, BLOCK_N, num_warps, num_stages) candidates {64x64 w4 s2 (current), 64x64 w4 s1, 64x64 w8 s2, 64x32 w4 s3, 128x64 w8 s2, 128x64 w8 s1, 128x32 w8 s2, 64x128 w8 s1}, keyed on SEQ_Q, SEQ_KV, CAUSAL, HEAD_DIM. Decode/split path and small-Sq path unchanged.

GQA group packing in the split-KV (decode) path: each split program handles one KV head and packs the GROUP query heads (x query positions) that share it into the M dimension (row r -> seq r//GROUP, head kvh*GROUP + r%GROUP), so every K/V tile is loaded once per KV head instead of once per query head. Grid becomes (num_splits, cdiv(Sq*GROUP, BLOCK_M)*Hkv, B); split count is recomputed from the packed base grid; workspace layout and combine kernel unchanged.

exp2 softmax with log2(e) folded into the scale: in every attention kernel (_attn_fwd prefill/small, _attn_fwd_split decode) keep the raw qk = tl.dot(q, k), use qk_scale = scale * log2(e), compute m_new = max(m_i, rowmax(qk) * qk_scale) and p = exp2(qk * qk_scale - m_new), alpha = exp2(m_i - m_new). The split kernel stores its LSE in the log2 domain (m_i + log2(l_i)) and the combine kernel weights splits with exp2, so the math stays consistent. No tile/schedule changes.
